      <title>Toptal: [PT/FT] Senior Roblox Developer & Game Designer</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country />
      <state />
      <skills />
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> 
</p>

<p>Summary</p><p>We are seeking an experienced Roblox Developer or small development team to build a polished Roblox experience from concept through launch. The experience will be promoted to a large kids-and-families audience, with a strong focus on engagement, scalability, and player retention.</p><p>General information</p><p>This project is being developed for two major social media creators with a combined audience of 20M+ followers. The Roblox experience is expected to be heavily promoted across their social platforms, so the build needs to support a high-quality player experience and scale effectively as adoption grows.</p><p>The role covers end-to-end ownership across product planning, development, launch support, and post-launch iteration. This is initially a project-based engagement, with potential for ongoing development and support if the initial launch performs well.</p><p>Tasks and Deliverables</p><ul><li>We are looking for a developer/team that can own the project A–Z, including:</li><li>Game concept and gameplay planning</li><li>Roblox Studio development</li><li>Map/world design</li><li>3D assets and environments</li><li>Luau scripting</li><li>Core gameplay mechanics</li><li>Multiplayer systems</li><li>UI/UX</li><li>Player progression and rewards</li><li>Data saving</li><li>Monetization systems</li><li>Mobile, tablet, PC, and console optimization</li><li>Testing, debugging, and QA</li><li>Roblox publishing and launch support</li><li>Analytics and performance tracking</li><li>Post-launch updates and improvements</li></ul><p>Required experience</p><ul><li>Strong portfolio of published Roblox experiences</li><li>Deep experience with Roblox Studio and Luau</li><li>Experience building games designed for large player counts</li><li>Strong understanding of retention, progression, monetization, and Roblox game loops</li><li>Experience optimizing Roblox experiences across devices</li><li>Able to take ownership of both the technical development and overall product</li><li>Strong communication and project-management skills</li><li>Experience launching and maintaining successful Roblox games is highly preferred</li></ul>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/toptal-pt-ft-senior-roblox-developer-game-designer">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/toptal-pt-ft-senior-roblox-developer-game-designer</a></p>
</description>
